body:
## Summary

Promote the complete shared helper surface from `tests/test_common.py` into the installable `flydsl.testing` API requested by the feature proposal.

- Adds public correctness, benchmarking/profiling, iteration, logging, and tensor I/O helpers under `flydsl.testing`.
- Keeps `tests.test_common` as an object-identical compatibility re-export rather than maintaining two implementations.
- Migrates repository callers and the testing/benchmarking guide to the public import path.
- Preserves existing callable signatures.
- Makes tensor dumps handle non-contiguous tensors and every tested element size, and replaces executable `eval` metadata parsing with validated parsing while retaining the existing file format.
- Adds compatibility, regression, and adversarial tests plus retained raw evidence under `reports/j-e7ed013abe3c/`.

Upstream issue: https://github.com/ROCm/FlyDSL/issues/304

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/FlyDSL/issues/670

Related work inspected: https://github.com/ROCm/FlyDSL/pull/829 was closed without merging and explicitly covered only a smaller `flydsl.profiling.do_bench` extraction; it did not move the broader `tests/test_common.py` API requested here.

## Reproduction and validation

Before this change, the requested import fails:

```bash
PYTHONPATH="$PWD/python" /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e7ed013abe3c/venv/bin/python -c \
  'from flydsl.testing import checkAllclose, run_perftest'
# ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'flydsl.testing'
```

Final regression and GPU numerical suite:

```bash
PYTHONPATH="$PWD/python:$PWD" \
  /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-e7ed013abe3c/venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/unit/test_testing.py \
  tests/unit/test_compile_hints.py \
  tests/kernels/test_vec_add.py -q
# 28 passed, 2 skipped
```

This ran three actual compiled FlyDSL vector-add cases on one AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950. A separate direct `run_perftest` HIP-event test performed eight measured GPU additions and matched an independently generated NumPy CPU float32 reference for 4096 elements exactly (`max_abs_error=0.0`, measured latency `7.255 us`). Commands and raw output are retained in `reports/j-e7ed013abe3c/raw/`.

Style gate:

```bash
PATH=/tmp/amdpilot-style-j-e7ed013abe3c/bin:$PATH \
BASE_SHA=acf7e67b7d22847e345938ca54fcc137bd7b2a1f \
bash scripts/check_python_style.sh --include-local
# passed with Black 26.5.1 and Ruff 0.16.6
```

## Limitations

- No C++ or LLVM source changed, so the prepared native rebuild was not applicable. GPU execution used the pinned native library at `/opt/venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/flydsl/_mlir` with this checkout's Python sources.
- CUDA/NVIDIA hardware was unavailable and is not claimed; GPU validation was ROCm/HIP on gfx950.
- The moved HIP graph mode and `torch.profiler` timing mode are preserved without semantic changes but were not independently exercised in this run. The HIP-event timing path was exercised directly.
- Two compile-hint tests retained their existing architecture/feature skips. Exact output is in the report.
title: [Feature] Expose shared testing and benchmarking helpers
